D: The residents of a tiny Nevada town fight giant underground worms.
P: Serve the snacks when Burt and Heather defend their basement.
S: Chang's Market spiced nuts and crackling

Crunchy oven-baked pork crackling with chilli salt, served beside hot honey and cayenne roasted peanuts, the way a desert general store should. Score 600g pork rind finely, rub with 2 tsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge for 2 hours. Pat dry and roast at 230C for 30 minutes until blistered and crisp, then break into pieces and toss with chilli salt. Toss 250g raw peanuts with 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp cayenne, salt and 1 tbsp oil and roast at 180C for 12 minutes, stirring once.
Topside sliced thin, marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar and pepper overnight, dried at 70C for 4 hours.
M: Rump steaks and thick sausages grilled over coals, baked beans simmered with onion and molasses, coleslaw with a creamy vinegar dressing.
tinned beans and franks from the bunker

Smoky franks browned and simmered with onion, beans, molasses, mustard and smoked paprika until thick and glossy, with warm buttered cornbread. Slice 8 franks into coins and brown in a pot with 1 tbsp oil. Add 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp smoked paprika, 3 tbsp molasses, 1 tbsp American mustard and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 2 drained 400g tins cannellini beans and 250ml stock and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Bake cornbread mix in a hot buttered pan at 200C for 20 minutes.
W: gummy worms coming up through the dirt
Chocolate pudding set in cups, crushed chocolate biscuit dirt on top, gummy worms poking out.
K: Val and Earl's bourbon iced tea
the beer they never get to finish, so try this

Strong sweet tea chilled and mixed with bourbon, fresh lemon and peach, poured over ice in jars from the esky in the back of the truck. Brew 4 black tea bags in 800ml boiling water for 5 minutes and stir in 4 tbsp honey. Cool and chill. Slice 1 peach and 1 lemon. Fill 4 jars with ice and peach and lemon slices. Add 45ml bourbon to each and top with the tea. Stir and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

s.how: Slice 600g beef topside 3mm thick across the grain. Marinate overnight in 60ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Dry on racks at 70C with the oven door ajar for 4 hours until leathery.

m.how: Simmer 2 tins baked beans with a diced onion and 2 tbsp molasses for 20 minutes. Shred a quarter cabbage and toss with 100g mayo and a splash of vinegar. Grill 2 rump steaks and 4 thick sausages over hot coals and slice to share.

w.note: gummy worms coming up through the dirt
w.how: Whisk 600ml milk, 80g sugar, 3 tbsp cocoa and 3 tbsp cornflour in a pot over medium heat until thick. Pour into four cups and chill 2 hours. Top with 100g crushed chocolate biscuits and push gummy worms in so they poke out.
